text: Canonical residual pair statistics and on-demand metric schedules are implemented. Public recipes cover identity, diagonal variance precision, and fixed shrinkage-to-diagonal precision. Training-only and explicitly justified all-partitions residual policies bind source/residual revisions into edge records. Edge providers combine atomic statistics once, derive support-local solve handles on demand, retain covariance for inverse-quadratic shortcuts, report rank/condition/regularization, and retain no node-by-fold factors. Focused metric/relation/geometry suites are green.
